authority: Original Word and explicit Chinese-market amendment remain authoritative. Existing user authorization permits local reference-audio testing only; no GitHub publication, packaging or distribution performed.

changes.implementation: PuzzleGridUIView always refreshes action callbacks, but unchanged/HUD-only configure calls skip cell accessibility rebuild and display invalidation. Actual found/mark/error/preview/tutorial-target changes update affected cells’ spoken state and still request board redraw; language/lock/board replacement refresh full spoken state; geometry only updates when its rectangle changes.

Validate the exact bundled sheet alpha plane with SHA-256 and native Accelerate extraction, then use known transparent bounds. RGB color conversion no longer invalidates geometry. Changed sheets safely use the old scanner. All four output images remain byte-for-byte pixel-identical to the scanning path, with zero alpha scans for the bundled sheet.

changes.area: Local audio concurrency and swipe release
changes.implementation: Optional explicit concurrencyGroup supports shared effect channels while omitted groups retain per-event limits. Local Nice/Great/Excellent share one stop-oldest voice channel. A normal finishCurrent lift preserves active natural clip endings and can play at most one already-due cue from the same callback; future queue entries are discarded. Cancellation, background/lock/mute and a new gesture clear pending/old cues immediately.

baselineAndInitialFailures.meaning: Diagnostic tests passed while exposing undesirable current behavior: three concurrent Combo voices, natural182ms swipe clips cut at normal lift, and zero clips for accepted marks sharing the end callback. Passing diagnostics were not acceptable-experience sign-off.

baselineAndInitialFailures.cause: Full RGBA hash differed after asset compilation/color conversion, so safe fallback preserved pixels but did not remove alpha scans. Fixed alpha-only validation using native extraction.
